event.unknown_type: Unknown event type: {event_type} (version {payload_version}). The central server must be upgraded before the sites.
event.entity_mismatch: Event {event_type} must concern a "{expected}" entity, not "{actual}".
event.float_forbidden: Floating-point numbers are forbidden in events: use text for decimals.
site.not_initialized: This site node is not initialized yet (site identity missing). Run "nkap-site init".
site.identity_mismatch: This database already belongs to site {site_code}: it cannot be reused for another site.
sync.outbox_corrupted: Outbox event #{site_seq} was modified after its creation: sending is blocked, alert the administrator.
auth.invalid_site_token: Site synchronization token missing, invalid or revoked.
auth.site_already_registered: Site {site_code} (or this site identifier) is already registered.
auth.site_mismatch: A site may only send events in its own name and for its own company.
sync.batch_not_ordered: Batch refused: each event must appear once, in sequence order.
sync.event_mismatch: Event {event_id} was already received with different content: anomaly to investigate.
sync.seq_conflict: Event number {site_seq} is already used by another event: the site database may have been restored from an old backup.
sync.incomplete_tx: The transaction starting at event #{site_seq} is incomplete in this batch.
sync.entity_exists: Object {entity_id} already exists on the central server.
sync.integrity_error: Event #{site_seq} violates a constraint of the central database.
audit.chain_broken: Audit entry #{chain_seq} does not extend the log known to the central server: the site log may have been tampered with.
